data.name: Néolithe
data.description: Néolithe is a French industrial startup founded in 2019 near Angers that manufactures "Fossilizers" — containerized machines that shred non-recyclable waste, mix it with a proprietary binder, and press it into mineral aggregates called Anthropocite for use in non-structural concrete and road base. The company's primary business is waste treatment and construction-aggregate production; carbon storage (claimed at ~337-420 kg CO2e per tonne) is marketed as a co-benefit from avoiding landfill/incineration of biogenic waste fractions.
